Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
If I have 1 pool and there is a Villein in play, then can I play a
minion tap to gain pool from on of my vampires to pay the cost of
Minion tap or will playing the Minion Tap oust me?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


You can play it, and it will resolve. If you take 2 pool from the target
vampire, you'll end with 2 pool (pay 1 for the Minion Tap and gain 2 from the
vampire).

If there were two Villein's in play, though, you couldn't play it, since you
can't pay the 2-pool cost with only 1 pool.
